description: The bar chart compares the performance of various language models (LLMs) on two datasets, MATH-500 and AIME24, using the compute-optimized test-time scaling (TTS) method. The x-axis represents different LLMs, including CoT, Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct, o1-mini, DeepSeek-R1, GPT-4o, TTS, and o1-preview. The y-axis indicates the performance score, ranging from 0 to 100. In the MATH-500 dataset, Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct (blue) and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B (green) outperform the other models, with scores of 91.6 and 97.3, respectively. In the AIME24 dataset, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B (green) and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B (yellow) lead with scores of 63.3 and 79.8, respectively. The chart shows that smaller LLMs can achieve higher performance on these datasets when optimized for compute.
